$comment: Declared composition/verifier/runtime expectations for the uvs-uvb suite. Schema-level accept/reject cases are EXECUTABLE via conformance/schema-assertions.json (valid fixtures and fixtures/invalid/*), run with --schemas <ajv 2020 module url>. The expectations below become executable when the composition verifier and the kernel land; they are contract, not prose. UPDATE 2026-09-02: the verifier rules (conditions-are-pure, references-resolve, effects-within-declaration, results-are-handled) are now EXECUTABLE in the uvs-uvb-verifier suite (tools/uv-verify.mjs); the runtime rules (firing order, budget exhaustion) stay declared until the kernel.

vectors.note: a UVS condition calling a mutate-class intrinsic is refused against the intrinsic table
goto to an undeclared state and a uvb action naming a missing function are refusals by name
the union of called intrinsics effects stays inside the function declaration, proven before the first tick
a discarded result<T> fails verification: errors are values and values are obligations
charts fire in (composition rank, chart name) order; save/restore between two reactions preserves the remainder queue and the final state hash
an exhausted loop budget is a typed scenario error naming chart or function, never a hung tick
